items.title: How TBC Bank is bringing AI and service governance into software delivery
items.summary: Georgia’s leading financial institution connected specialized AI agents to its delivery and service workflows, with human approval for critical decisions. TBC Bank is one of Georgia’s leading financial institutions with 1.42 million daily active users, 40% market share, and more than 200 digital banking services.
